name: Payment Receipt
description: A clean receipt for a successful payment.
html_content:
Payment received

Hi {first_name},

Thanks — we've received your payment. Here are the details for your records:

  • Receipt #: {receipt_number}
  • Amount: {amount}
  • Date: {payment_date}
  • Method: {payment_method}

You can download a PDF copy any time from your billing dashboard.

If you have any questions about this charge, just reply to this email.

— {company_name} Billing
